title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Approved implementation dossier for a publicly browsable, execution-locked Agent Studio demo built from completed and deployed scenario snapshots. Slice S2 is delivered by AGT-2667 with the startup-only public-demo-readonly profile, a shared pure deny policy, direct execution-route tests, and fail-closed startup inventory proofs on the backend and Task Server. The remaining seed, replay, visitor edge, bundle, reset, and dedicated-VM launch slices remain pending.
